Method of Attack: Injected binary files and a compromised build process to introduce backdoor code
Backdoor operates by piggybacking off functions called by sshd, causing delays in connection attempts
Impacted Systems: x86-64 systems running glibc and using systemd to load sshd
Debian-based and Red-Hat-based distributions (e.g., Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian)
Attack Vector: Binary files added as part of a 'test suite'
Specific build-to-host.m4 file required for injection during compilation
Disruption of landlock detection by modifying CMakeLists.txt
Indicators of Compromise: Excessive CPU usage and 500 ms delay in sshd connection attempts
Presence of backdoor code that expects a specific public key for activation
